items.title: Splice's new AI DAW feels like a cheat code for music production
items.excerpt: Splice launches Create in beta: a free Mac DAW built around the Splice library with a voice-controlled AI chatbot, Rheo, that can teach you to make a track or assemble a full song from Splice samples and stock instruments.

items.title: Pro Tools now features AI stem separation
items.excerpt: Avid's Pro Tools 2026.11 adds an AI stem separation extension that splits any recording into up to six stems (vocals, drums, bass, guitar, keys, other) via drag-and-drop.
items.note: Release of the tool previewed at IBC (production-expert, published 09-15); stem separation hit 11-05 (Photon) - deprioritized slot

items.title: ElevenLabs now lets users publish AI-generated music directly on SoundCloud
items.excerpt: ElevenLabs' Eleven Music now publishes tracks straight to SoundCloud without a download step; the company says more than 25 million tracks have been generated with its music models.

items.title: You can post AI music straight to SoundCloud from ElevenLabs
items.excerpt: SoundCloud partners with another generative AI music service, ElevenLabs, letting Eleven Music users push AI-made songs directly to SoundCloud.
items.note: Same story as TechCrunch item - alternate source

items.title: DDEX Announces ElevenLabs as First AI Company to Join Membership
items.excerpt: Music metadata standards body DDEX has admitted ElevenLabs as its first AI-company member, bringing an AI music generator into the industry's delivery/metadata standards process.

items.title: Nile Rodgers Defends His Use of AI in New Music Video: "You're Being Hypocritical"
items.excerpt: Nile Rodgers pushes back at fans criticizing the AI-generated visuals in his upcoming music video for 'The Christmas Song' with Rebecca Ferguson.

items.title: Paid $200 for Logic Pro? Apple Says You Won't Get This New Feature
items.excerpt: Logic Pro 13.0 for Mac shipped today; per Apple's release notes, its AI-powered Intelligent Assistant requires an Apple Creator Studio subscription ($12.99/mo or $129/yr), so one-time $199 buyers don't get it.
items.note: OFF-LIST exception: Logic Pro 13 public release (beta covered 10-28; keywords ask for public release). No allowed-domain coverage of the 11-05 release found (musicradar/gearnews pieces are 10-28).

items.title: Apple Creator Studio App Updates Rolling Out, Starting With Logic Pro
items.excerpt: Apple began rolling out its announced Creator Studio app updates; both Creator Studio and standalone Logic Pro for Mac were updated today (Logic Pro 13 with AI assistant), with other apps later in November.
items.note: OFF-LIST exception, same Logic Pro 13 release story

items.title: Mods for everyone: inMusic is opening up MPC, more new gear to coders
items.excerpt: inMusic (Akai, Moog, Numark, Alesis, Denon) says many of its 22 January product launches will be open to modders and developers, including AI 'vibe coders' using tools like Claude Code and Codex alongside traditional developers.
items.note: Follow-up to 10-29 Akai vibe-coded firmware item - new: inMusic-wide policy

items.title: From Ticketing To Vocals, The 'Mind-Blowing' Ways Concerts Are Using AI
items.excerpt: How the live business is deploying AI across marketing, ticketing, production and on-stage vocals.

items.title: How IFPI CEO Victoria Oakley Is Tackling AI & Streaming Fraud Head-On: 'We've Got Work to Do'
items.excerpt: IFPI CEO Victoria Oakley on AI, streaming fraud and the collaborative process she says is needed to address the industry's most pressing issues.

items.title: Grimes to Star in the First-Ever AI-Generated Film Coming to Theaters: Watch a Clip
items.excerpt: Grimes stars in 'Gods Don't Give Gifts', billed as the first AI-generated feature film headed to theaters; Billboard shares a clip of her character.

items.title: Apple Doubles Down on Its Motion to Quash Suno's Deposition Subpoena
items.excerpt: Apple files a reply again opposing Suno's third-party deposition subpoena in the label lawsuits, calling the information sought 'irrelevant'.

items.title: Is Spotify's Anti-Spam Crackdown Catching Legitimate Music in the Crossfire?
items.excerpt: Evidence suggests Spotify's filter against AI-driven slop and spam uploads may be suppressing discovery of legitimate recordings, per 11A founder Austin Staubus.

items.title: 5 things to know about CISAC's global report, as songwriter royalty collections hit record $15.9B in 2025, with $900M+ from The MLC, and AI in focus
items.excerpt: CISAC's global collections report: record $15.9B songwriter royalties in 2025, with AI flagged as a central concern.

items.title: PianoBench: Evaluating Musical Perception and Reasoning in Language Models
items.excerpt: New benchmark and 20,000+ hour multimodal piano dataset (interleaved audio, symbolic transcripts and speech) testing which musical features multimodal language models can actually perceive and reason about.

items.title: Text-to-music Generation via Structured Captions and Interpretable Evaluation
items.excerpt: Trains latent diffusion/flow text-to-music models on structured captions (SCAPs) vs free-form prompts, with controlled ablations on caption coverage and temporal conditioning.
